Name: Empty Jar Bubbles
Author: temisthem
Description:
[b][size=4]Leave no jar behind! Never forget to stuff your jars full of love before starting your day!

Customize the size, opacity, offset, and speed of the indicator emote!

*Also works with kegs, casks, and other vanilla machines. [/size][/b]

[size=3]If you're anything like me, you'll spend an extra 10 minutes in your jar area making sure that you didn't leave any jars empty. With this, save yourself the 10 minutes and go on with your day with full confidence knowing that you didn't miss a single jar.

[b][size=6]Requirements:[/size]
[/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)

[b][size=6]Mod Compatibility:[/size]
[/b]
[CP] mods that patch Data/Machines.json are compatible. Please enable "Modded Machines Enabled" in the config to allow this. 
[b]Note: [/b]Modded machines cannot be configured, so if enabled, ALL modded machines will render bubbles when empty

[b][size=6]Configuration:[/size]
[/b]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[size=6][b]Multiplayer Compatibility:
[/b][/size]
Only makes client-side changes, so it will only affect those who have it installed.
[/size]
[b][size=6]Source Code:
[/size][/b]
